# ArviStay: code map

<!-- generated by APP_MAKER/standard/app_map.py · 2026-11-08 · code 3a4c4f273db4 · regenerate after every change -->

**Read this first, then open only the files it points to.** Line numbers are where definitions start; read
around them with an offset instead of whole files.

**What it is:** Make a beautiful Art Nouveau website for your hotel: rooms, videos, 360-degree tours, a 3D neighbourhood map and an hour-by-hour stay plan for every kind of guest.
**Live:** https://arvistay.com · **Repo:** github.com/arkulinskis/hotel-websites-platform · **Layout:** native Anvil Forms · **Deploy:** master
**Guide** (workflow, design rules, product knowledge): `.claude/skills/arvistay/SKILL.md`

## How to change it

- **New page**: copy a similar `client_code/Pages/<Name>/` (form_template.html + __init__.py), register it in
  `client_code/router.py` (`PAGES`, `_form()`, and `NAV` for the menu). Address = `#name/arg`.
- **New list**: a RepeatingPanel in the page template + `client_code/Items/<Name>/`. **Dialog**: `client_code/Dialogs/<Name>/` opened with `alert(...)`.
- **New server function**: `@anvil.server.callable` in the matching `server_code` module (see *Server*), called with `state.call("name", ...)`.
- **New table/column**: `anvil.yaml` → `db_schema` (the user accepts Anvil's Schema Mismatch alert); update the server-test mock.
- **Drawing/media/canvas**: a JavaScript engine in `theme/assets/` wrapped by a Python module or a `Components/` form.
- **Styles**: `theme/assets/app.css` (colour tokens at the top; rules in APP_MAKER/design/README.md).
- **Check**: `python tools/check.py` → ALL CHECKS PASSED; UI: `python -I tools/ui_test.py` (Docker Desktop running).
- **Deploy**: commit as arkulinskis (+ Co-Authored-By) and `git push` (master unless apps.json says branch-first).
- **Footer** must keep: Submit feedback (Prepsto), Privacy & Terms, Contact developer (arkvital.com), Parent company (addanapp.com).
- **After any change**: `python -I C:/Users/arkvi/Documents/CLAUDE/APP_MAKER/standard/app_map.py nouveaustay` refreshes this map.

## Notes

<!-- NOTES: hand-written, kept when the map is regenerated -->
- **Hosted hotel sites** are server-rendered by `server_code/Hosting.py` (`/s/:slug`) and load `theme/assets/ns-site.js/.css`
  with `?v=SITE_V`. Those two files are BUILT from `site/*` by `python -I tools/build_site.py` (it also writes
  `server_code/site_version.py`); never edit them by hand. check.py fails when they are out of date.
- **Engines stay JavaScript**: `ns-site.js` (renderer, shared with hosted sites and exports), `ns-app.js` (NSApp uploads/export/
  starter site, NSScan geocode/scan, the small `window.UI` helpers), `ns-editor.js` (NSEd: the editor's nine field tabs, the
  live preview iframe, the visits chart). `client_code/ns.py` is the bridge: `window.NS_HOST` (server calls whitelisted in
  `ENGINE_CALLS`, uploads via `anvil.js.to_media`, toast, confirm) + Python helpers that return plain values (JSON text).
- **Editor split**: `Pages/Edit` owns the frame, autosave (`save_site` with `version`; conflict -> reload), tabs, the Publish
  tab (`Components/PublishPanel`), the photo picker (`Dialogs/Library`, returns refs or "upload") and `leave()` (the router
  calls it; it saves what's left and stops the engines). NSEd calls the page's hooks: changed, tab, persona, library, previewMsg.
  `SECTION_TAB`/`TAB_SECTION` exist in both ns-editor.js and Pages/Edit: keep them equal.
- **Wizard** (`Pages/New`): the scan runs from a `window.setTimeout` so the page stays live while NSScan works; the map is
  `Components/HotelMap` (mounts on show: MapLibre needs a size). Tests: `NS_TEST_SCAN`, `NS_NO_MAP`.
- `window.nsTestCall(name, argsJson)` (startup.py) lets tools/ui/smoke.js make the same server calls as the pages.
- The showcase seed generator (`tools/make_seed.py` + scan cache) stayed in the old source folder; `server_code/showcase_data.py`
  is its output.
- Validator: values it would pin to None / literal types go through `_loose(x)` (Edit, PublishPanel, Sites, ns.py).
<!-- /NOTES -->

## Tools

- `tools/assets.py`: Refresh the theme assets' cache-busting hashes in anvil.yaml (and icons.css).
- `tools/build_icons.py`: Write theme/assets/icons.css from the icon table in theme/assets/lh-kit.js (UI.ICONS).
- `tools/build_site.py`: The hotel-website renderer: site/*.js -> theme/assets/ns-site.js, site/*.css -> theme/assets/ns-sit…
- `tools/check.py`: Everything that must pass before pushing. Ends with ALL CHECKS PASSED.
- `tools/make_icons.py`: Make the PNG app icons from theme/assets/icon.svg (headless Chrome draws them).
- `tools/ui_test.py`: Run the app for real in the open-source Anvil App Server (Docker) and drive it with headless Chrome.
